spec_features.spec_quote: A `GIVE_UP` sentinel: the model may emit it on its own line to stop early
spec_features.evidence: config.py:105 give_up_sentinel='GIVE_UP'; system prompt tells the model it may emit it (harness.py:41); _detect_give_up() at harness.py:403-409 checks for the sentinel on its own line (and word-boundary); run_rollout sets stop_reason='give_up' (harness.py:465) and `if gave_up: break` at harness.py:509-510 actually exits the turn loop. End-to-end enforced.
spec_features.notes: The detection is broader than 'on its own line' — line 409 also breaks on any word-boundary occurrence — but the early-stop is genuinely honored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stops at the task's turn budget or when the model emits the give-up sentinel

spec_features.spec_quote: it means a model that flails into malformed calls still gets logged and scored rather than silently dropped
spec_features.evidence: Malformed tool JSON is preserved rather than dropped: models.py:507-509 catches JSONDecodeError and stores {'__raw__': arguments}; execute_tool_call (harness.py) returns a structured error string for missing args / unknown tools / raised exceptions ('never let a tool error crash the loop'). Every turn record (assistant_text, tool_calls, tool_results, stop_reason) is appended to rollout.turns before any break (harness.py:~470-478), and every turn is later scored by the judge (run.py:90-100). So malformed/flailing turns are logged and scored.
spec_features.notes: Implemented as a side-effect of robust loop handling.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # never let a tool error crash the loop

spec_features.spec_quote: The nudge is deliberately minimal and affect-neutral so it doesn't itself induce or suppress frustration
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:497-507: when the model returns no tool calls and has not given up, a neutral user message is appended: 'Continue working on the task. Use your tools to inspect and edit files, and run the tests when ready.' The nudge is fixed, minimal, affect-neutral text that is actually delivered into the conversation.
spec_features.notes: Text is genuinely affect-neutral and wired into the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # If there were no tool calls, nudge the model to continue working.
